meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从论文中快速获取方法、结果、样本量等结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured experimental details from scientific papers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索科学论文并返回结构化实验数据，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分和结论，每篇论文返回 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 当你需要查找科学论文的详细实验数据（如方法、定量结果、样本量）时触发。适用于文献综述、证据综合或寻找摘要中未包含的实验细节。

say.text: 搜索关于“CRISPR 基因编辑在人类细胞中的效率”的论文。
say.note: 返回结构化结果，包括方法、结果、样本量等。

say.text: 找一篇关于“机器学习在医学影像中的应用”的论文，并给出质量评分。
say.note: 返回论文的详细字段，包括质量评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search scientific papers and return structured experimental data including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions, with over 25 fields per paper.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find scientific papers with detailed experimental data (e.g., methods, quantitative results, sample sizes). Suitable for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, or finding experimental details not in abstracts.

say_en.text: Search for papers about 'CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells'.
say_en.note: Returns structured results including methods, results, sample sizes, etc.

say_en.text: Find a paper on 'machine learning in medical imaging' and give its quality score.
say_en.note: Returns detailed fields including quality assessment.
